newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Ras Tanura refinery set for Aug maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Ras Tanura refinery set for Aug maintenance.

text.p: A 30-day maintenance shutdown has been scheduled starting next month at Saudi Aramco's 265,000 barrels per day (bpd) Ras Tanura oil refinery, Gulf oil traders and industry sources said on Monday.
The work, expected to start in the second half of August, will shut the refinery's single crude distillation unit though reforming units will stay up to ensure gasoline supplies, the sources said.

A $1.5 billion upgrading and expansion programme at the Gulf plant is expected to be commissioned in June 1998, boosting capacity to 300,000 bpd and raising middle distillate and gasoline yields, according to oil industry sources.
